description: Registers an adult user's interest in the Founding Fifty pre-launch programme. Current benefits and availability require confirmation; signup does not confirm a tasting, discount or delivery date. Only call with explicit consent: it stores contact details in SOMA's CRM and sends a one-time welcome email. Idempotent: signing up twice never double-sends.

city.description: The user's city, so SOMA knows where to launch next (optional)

email.description: The user's email address (required, with their consent)

name: join_waitlist
title: Join the SOMA Founding Fifty waitlist
